name: Navalilla (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a white band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalilla (quartered per saltire, pines on white and sheep on green).
history: The flag of Navalilla was published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 22 September 2000 and the arms and flag were approved officially on 29 March 2003; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, green, with a white stripe running from the upper corner nearest the hoist.
